trend_summary: Sources (Oct 2026 refresh): BLS Employment Projections 2025-35 project total US employment +3.5%; WEF Future of Jobs 2025 projects 170M jobs created and 92M displaced by 2030 with 39% of core skills changing; McKinsey Global Institute (Nov 2025) estimates demonstrated technologies could in theory automate ~57% of US work hours (44% agents, 13% robots). Per-occupation exposure and wages now in data/occupations/.
